name: Perfect Dark XBLA PC Recomp
summary: A native Windows PC version of Perfect Dark from the 2010 Xbox 360 Xbox Live Arcade remaster by Rare and 4J Studios. Created through static recompilation with ReXGlue. It runs at 60 FPS at up to 4K with keyboard and mouse or Xbox controller support and features built-in LAN/Virtual LAN multiplayer for up to 8 players and 2-player co-op.
